title: Per-plant methane potential estimates and analysis code for China's above-ground municipal WWTPs
description: Analysis code and derived data accompanying 'Concentrated distribution and targeted deployment of methane resources in China's municipal wastewater treatment plants.' Contains: (1) reproducible Python pipeline (wwtp_model, Monte Carlo, distribution fitting, recoverable scenarios) with verification against published values; (2) per-plant methane estimates for 2,457 above-ground WWTPs; (3) all figure-generation scripts and their input CSV files. Running run_all.py reproduces every quantitative result from the raw plant dataset in about 90 seconds.
